verdict.rationale: Zulip's official export docs describe org-wide export tools with explicit tiers including 'Public and private data (with consent)' covering private channel messages and DMs from consenting members, and a separate full-export type requiring a support request — directly matching the compliance-export story for a team-admin. This is corroborated by multiple docs pages ([zulip-docs-6],[zulip-docs-10]) describing export/import tooling used for migration and backup. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the exact machine-readable file format and community validation that exports work as documented (one community comment notes a general wish for 'better admin and audit tools').
